text:
alex: Heads-up, after merging role-matrix-rewrite today a handful of viewer/editor roles lost the billing permission at org-scope. Billing page shows 403 for some viewers even though org API shows viewer role. Repro below. :grimacing:

 greta: Which deploy tag? @omar can you triage?

 alex: Deploy tag: role-matrix-rewrite-2026-06-10 (deploy-bot posted it). Example: user u_5578 in org-501, project p_analytics_3 -> Billing 403. API: `GET /api/v1/orgs/org-501/permissions?user=u_5578` -> `{ "user":"u_5578", "role":"viewer", "permissions":["view_project","billing:read"] }` but `GET /api/v1/projects/p_analytics_3/permissions?user=u_5578` -> `{ "user":"u_5578", "role": null, "permissions":[] }`. UI hides Billing link based on project perms check.

 omar: Sounds like the mapper created an explicit empty project assignment instead of leaving it nil/inherit. Check `rbac_roles` rows for that project.

 alex: DB snippet: `select resource_id, role_alias, scope, encrypted_alias from rbac_roles where resource_id='p_analytics_3';` -> returns `p_analytics_3 | null | project | ""`. Looks like alias was set to empty string.

 infra-bot: deploy-bot: "deployment role-matrix-rewrite-2026-06-10 finished at 2026-06-10T17:02Z"

 sec-oncall: Impact P2 (UX/regression). Security risk low but customer-facing. We need: 1) migrator audit + run id, 2) KMS decrypt audit during migration, 3) quick mitigation.

 greta: Checked audit: migrator run id=mig-20260610-11 by svc rbac-migrator@infra at 2026-06-10T17:00Z. KMS logs show multiple transient `DECRYPT_NOT_AUTHORIZED` between 17:01:05Z-17:01:35Z for key projects/ri/locations/global/keyRbac, attempts abc-1..abc-3, then success.

 omar: If alias expansion reads encrypted alias and a decrypt fails mid-org, migrator could write a blank alias and mark org as partial. Check `rbac_migration` table for state.

 alex: Query: `select org_id, state, run_id from rbac_migration where org_id='org-501';` -> `org-501 | partial | mig-20260610-11`.

 frontend: Temporary UX mitigation: I'll change client to fall back to org-perms when project perms empty, behind flag `ui.rbac.project-fallback`. That avoids 403 and shows Billing until we fix DB. Also add tooltip: "Using org-level permissions".

 sec-oncall: Good. Also ensure we record these soft-fallback events with telemetry `rbac.ui.fallback_used`.

 omar: Plan: 1) requeue migrator for org-501 with verbose logging and KMS retry/backoff, 2) if migrator remains partial run idempotent SQL backfill for that org only, 3) capture full KMS audit to S3 and attach to INC-20260610-3.

 greta: Requeued: infra-bot queued job migrator-reconcile org=org-501 run_id=mig-20260610-11-retry verbose=true (eta ~90s). Logs -> https://logs.redwood.ai/mig-20260610-11-retry

 infra-bot: migrator run mig-20260610-11-retry started at 2026-06-10T17:04Z.

 alex: Repro commands I used:
```
# repro
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/p_analytics_3/permissions?user=u_5578" | jq
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/org-501/permissions?user=u_5578" | jq
```

 nom ar: (typo) omar: migrator retry finished at 2026-06-10T17:12Z; status for org-501 -> complete. Verified KMS retried and succeeded. Post-run check: `select state from rbac_migration where org_id='org-501'` -> `complete`.

 frontend: After migrator done, project perms now include `billing:read`. Verified with user u_5578 and toggled `ui.rbac.project-fallback=false`. No soft-fallback events recorded (telemetry 0).

 sec-oncall: Closing immediate incident. Follow-ups: - add KMS permission sanity check as part of migrator startup, - add exponential backoff & retries in migrator KMS calls, - add migration post-check that no blank aliases exist, - add alert when `rbac_migration.state='partial'` for >5m. Assign owners in INC-20260610-3.

 alex: For reference safe backfill SQL (only if retry fails):
```
UPDATE rbac_roles
SET role_alias = 'viewer', permissions = permissions || '{billing:read}'
WHERE org_id='org-501' AND resource_type='project' AND (role_alias IS NULL OR role_alias='') AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM rbac_roles rr WHERE rr.org_id='org-501' AND rr.role_alias='viewer' AND rr.resource_type='org'
);
```

 greta: I'll add a lint in CI to flag migrations that touch encrypted columns without explicit KMS retry logic.

 omar: Added run ids and logs to INC-20260610-3. Thanks team. :lock:
